maona = {
	color = subject_vassal #subject_maona
	level = 1
	annullment_favours_required = 10

	# No monthly payments — the Maona's value is the one-time lump sum at creation
	# and the trade influence it transfers to the overlord.
	# subject_pays = none

	join_offensive_wars_always = {
		always = no
	}
	join_offensive_wars_can_call = {
		# Overlord can call the Maona to naval wars in its region
		scope:actor = { is_subject_of = scope:recipient }
	}
	join_defensive_wars_always = {
		# Maona always defends its overlord
		scope:actor = {
			is_subject_of = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	has_overlords_ruler = no
	can_be_annexed = no  # Charter system handles lifecycle, not annexation

	strength_vs_overlord = -0.1

	diplomatic_capacity_cost_scale = 0.25

	subject_can_cancel = no   # Bound by charter
	overlord_can_cancel = no  # Bound by charter — expiry event handles dissolution

	has_limited_diplomacy = yes

	allow_declaring_wars = {
		always = no
		# Maone can wage small wars to protect their trade interests
		# maona_can_declare_wars_trigger = yes #todo
	}

	fleet_basing_rights = yes
	food_access = no

	can_change_rank = no
	can_change_heir_selection = no

	use_overlord_map_color = yes
	use_overlord_map_name = yes

	can_overlord_recruit_regiments = no
	can_overlord_build_ships = yes  # Overlord can build ships in Maona ports
	can_overlord_build_roads = yes
	can_overlord_build_buildings = yes
	can_overlord_build_rgos = yes

	overlord_protects_external = yes
	overlord_protects_other_subjects = no

	can_be_force_broken_in_peace_treaty = yes

	minimum_opinion_for_offer = 100

	great_power_score_transfer = 0.5

	merchants_to_overlord_fraction = 0.75  # Core mechanic — Maona funnels most trade to overlord

	government = republic

	institution_spread_to_overlord = monthly_institution_spread_mild
	institution_spread_to_subject = monthly_institution_spread_mild

	overlord_modifier = {
		trade_efficiency = tiny_trade_efficiency_bonus
		global_merchant_capacity_modifier = 0.025
	}

	subject_modifier = {
		trade_efficiency = small_trade_efficiency_bonus
		loyalty_to_overlord = 10
	}

	creation_visible = {
		has_advance = maona_advance
		# always = no  # Created through Compagna parliament, not diplomacy
	}

	visible_through_diplomacy = {
		tag = GEN
		# has_advance = maona_advance
		#scope:target = {
		#	has_country_flag = is_genoese_maona
		#	subject_type_is_not_locked = yes
		#}
	}

	visible_through_treaty = {
		always = no  # Not obtainable through peace treaties
	}

	on_enable = {
		# Set charter duration flag — used by monthly tick to check expiry
		# Actual duration (20-50 years) set by the parliament resolution that creates the Maona
    	add_reform = government_reform:maona_charter
        international_organization:compagna_communis_ianuensis = {
			add_country_to_international_organization = root
			international_organization_add_special_status = {
    			type = special_status:cci_maona
    			country = root
    		}
		}
	}

	on_disable = {
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_subject = {
		base = -20
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		diplomatic_reputation = 1
		same_common_language = 5
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
	}

	diplo_chance_accept_overlord = {
		base = 15
		negative_opinion = -5
		positive_opinion = 0.25
		trust_in_actor = 0.2
	}
}
